Dear [Mr Wodehouse](/person/1548)
I shall be delighted to see another story of [Miss Gordon](/person/569)’s.[^2] I am in hopes that her icelandic one will appear in the [Packet](/periodical/52) in February or March, and indeed I was thinking of writing to ask where she was that I might send her the proofs, it is indeed a long time since we have met, and as my [brother](/person/1624) and [sister](/person/1604) have gone out and left us their cavalry, we are meditating driving to Easton some day, when we might bring home the MS. Would you or [Lady Elinor](/person/1547) be so kind as to let us know whether we should find you at home if we presented ourselves at luncheon the first fine day next week?
Yours very truly

C M Yonge


[^2]: Mary Charlotte Julia Gordon (1840-1926), later (1865) Mrs Disney Leith, was a niece of Lady Elinor Wodehouse, who was sister to her mother and to the mother of Algernon Swinburne, with whom Mary Gordon collaborated on a story The Children of the Chapel (1864).
